title: L HUB Best script for the game
features:
🚜 Auto Farm & Mining
Auto Break Blocks: Automatically farms Lucky Blocks and Brainrots.
Dynamic Targeting: Intelligently targets valid blocks.
Priority Modes:
Highest HP: Prioritizes targeting the largest blocks.
Lowest HP: Targets the weakest blocks for fast farming efficiency.
Oldest (Ancient): Targets blocks that spawned the longest ago.
Random: Random targeting to avoid detectable patterns.
Smart Stickiness: Locks onto the targeted block until destruction to avoid incessant target switching.

🎒 Auto Collection & Filters
Smart Auto Collect: Automatically collects dropped items.
Rarity Filter: Select which rarities to collect (Common, Rare, Legendary, God, Secret, etc.).
Brainrot Name Filter (PRIORITY): Dynamic list of all in-game Brainrots. If a selected Brainrot drops, it is collected with priority (override), regardless of its rarity or cash value.
Min Cash Filter: Set a minimum cash value to collect an item (e.g., ignore anything worth less than $10k).
Collect Depth: Adjustable teleport distance below ground for safe/stealthy item collection.

⚔️ Combat & Defense
Kill Aura: Automatically attacks nearby entities (Lucky Blocks and Sammy).
Auto Equip Best: Automatically equips the best pickaxe/weapon in your inventory before attacking.
Anti-Sammy:
Freeze: Freezes Sammy in place.
Exile: Teleports Sammy under the map (-2000 studs).
Kick: Locally deletes Sammy/The reaper.

👤 Player Quality of Life
Auto Buy Pickaxes: Automatically purchases the next best pickaxe as soon as you have enough cash.
Auto Equip Best Pickaxe: Always checks and equips your best available pickaxe.
Safe Zone: Teleports your character to a safe zone (anti-void / shop roof) with a single click.
Return Speed: Adjustable return speed after item collection.

📊 Stats & Webhooks
Session Stats: Displays play time, cash earned, blocks broken, and rare items found in the current session.
Discord Webhooks: Sends notifications to your Discord when finding rare items or for full inventory reports.
Inventory Report: Generates a detailed report of everything in your inventory (supports item stacking).
